purpose: Independent read-only evidence/data-contract check of completed uniform reference-reduction and paired base training CV
methods: Read stored protocols, cohort plan and inputs, reduction results and selected audit records; independently recompute file hashes, physical design hashes, resource pairs, balanced selections, fold assignments and reported CV metrics. No optimization, model fit, or physical audit was repeated.

scope_and_findings.protocol: Three scripts differ only in stated group selection, output destination, descriptive strings, and script name hash; same algorithm and repair budget. Each protocol recorded script and repair-source hashes match current files; import snapshot is retrospective, not proof of earlier or complete execution environment.
scope_and_findings.coverage: 192 unique train cases: groups 1000-1031, six families each. All current input file hashes match corresponding result parent_sha256, and case identity matches cohort plan. 158 have selected witnesses; 34 are unknown, not infeasible.
scope_and_findings.stored_evidence: All 192 result summaries match same complete balanced-selected archive witness or unknown, original selected witness retained; all 467 stored witness physical hashes, resource counts/thicknesses and stored audit identities/target/constraint status match their design. All 158 selected points match the independently generated original-request reaudit records by hash, N and D; no physical solver was rerun by this review.
scope_and_findings.training_holdout: Only training plan case identities used. Objective counts 1/2/3 = 64/96/32; material ids low/high/middle/glass; none of four actual holdout (wavelength range, metric) pairs occurs exactly. Exact-pair test alone does not prove all possible neighboring-task leakage excluded.
scope_and_findings.timeout_boundary: 16 cases stopped at declared 60 s. Original witness and completed solve-round outputs survive; a StopRequested inside solve discards local in-progress-round archive, potentially including already-audited candidates; no claim that every discovered candidate survives.
scope_and_findings.cv: Paired CV uses 158 base rows only, same fixed NPZ features and 32 groups; each modulo-8 fold has four groups. All old and revised label pairs, case identities, result-source hashes, original-request audit matches and recorded overall/family metric recomputations pass. 112 paired labels changed. Original N MAE 4.582278481012659 and D MAPE 0.29211963154669834; revised 3.8797468354430378 and 0.2641672587095027. Both remain worse than gates N<=3 and D<=0.25. Training CV, not blind external assessment or true-minimum error.

limitations: Physical objectives were not independently recalculated in this check; conclusions rely on stored numerical audit records.
Independent import/provenance snapshot was captured after the runs began, not pre-frozen, and may omit dynamic imports.
Timeout may lose candidates in current solve call; original cohort files remain intact and existing completed evidence remains auditable.
The 192-output encoding equivalence JSON reports matched count but does not include per-case comparisons.
